Prestige Golf — Privacy Policy

Data controller / responsible party: FourX Games Proprietary Limited Registration number 2026/552177/07 (Republic of South Africa) Registered address: 30 Fifth Street, Menlopark, Pretoria, South Africa Website: https://FourXGames.com · Privacy contact: privacy@fourxgames.com Information Officer (POPIA): Leroux Fourie

Effective date: 26 September 2026 · Version: 1.2

This policy explains what personal information we collect when you play Prestige Golf or use FourXGames.com, why we collect it, who we share it with, how long we keep it, and the rights you have. It is written to satisfy the South African Protection of Personal Information Act ("POPIA"), the EU/UK General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR"), US state privacy laws including the California Consumer Privacy Act ("CCPA/CPRA"), and the privacy requirements of the Apple App Store and Google Play.

The short version: we collect what we need to run a fair online golf game — your account details, your gameplay, and technical data. We do not sell your personal information, we do not show third-party advertising, and the Game contains no advertising or tracking SDKs.

1. What we collect

a. Account information (registered accounts): email address; password (stored only as a salted cryptographic hash — we cannot read it); sign-in tokens. Guest accounts have no email address and no password: we create an account identifier for you and keep your sign-in token on your device. A guest account otherwise holds the same profile and gameplay information as a registered one (b and c below) — the difference is that we hold no way to identify or contact you, and no way to restore your progress if you lose the device.

b. Profile information: display name; avatar selection; country (optional); in-game handicap, XP, career tier and progression; equipment and purchases made with in-game currency.

c. Gameplay data: rounds, sessions and scores; every shot's inputs and server-validated outcomes (club, power, positions, distances, lie, spin); per-shot analytics used for your statistics (for example distance-to-pin and surface before/after each shot); saved mid-round games.

d. Purchase data: the items you bought, store transaction identifiers and entitlements. Payment is processed by Apple or Google — we never receive your card details.

e. Technical data: IP address; request identifiers, timestamps, and server logs (which record the requests your device makes, including standard request headers); connectivity state (for offline-play sync).

f. Crash and diagnostic data: when the Game crashes, stops responding or logs an error, it sends a crash report to Unity's Diagnostics service so we can find and fix the fault. A report contains the technical details of the fault (the error, a stack trace and app performance data), your device model, operating system version, the Game's version, and a randomly generated installation identifier created by the Unity engine. We do not attach your account, email address or display name to these reports, and they contain no gameplay, purchase or contact information.

g. Support data: correspondence when you contact us.

h. Push notification tokens (only if/when you enable notifications).

Website (FourXGames.com): the Site uses only strictly necessary cookies, and no analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies. It also loads no third-party content: the fonts and scripts it needs are served from our own domain, so visiting the Site does not disclose your IP address to anyone else.

We do not collect: real names (unless you put one in your display name), precise location, contacts, photos, biometric data, or advertising identifiers.

Under POPIA, we process personal information on the corresponding grounds in section 11 (performance of a contract, protecting your or our legitimate interests, legal obligations, and consent where indicated). We do not use your personal information for direct marketing without your consent, and any marketing message will include an opt-out. We do not carry out automated decision-making with legal or similarly significant effect: anti-cheat flags are reviewed with human involvement before account-level penalties are applied.

3. Who we share it with

We do not sell personal information and do not share it for cross-context behavioural advertising. We share it only with:

  • Amazon Web Services (processor): our game servers and databases run on Amazon Web Services infrastructure in the United States (AWS region us-east-1). AWS hosts and stores the data on our behalf under its data processing addendum; it does not use it for its own purposes. Databases are encrypted in transit, and access is restricted to our own application servers.
  • Cloudflare, Inc. (processor): all traffic between your device and our servers passes through Cloudflare's network, which provides the secure connection (TLS), protects the service from attack, and delivers course downloads. Cloudflare therefore processes your requests and IP address in transit on our behalf. Cloudflare also stores and delivers our game content (such as course downloads).
  • Unity Technologies (processor): the Unity engine that runs the Game sends crash and diagnostic reports (section 1f) to Unity's Diagnostics service, which stores them and shows them to us so we can fix faults. Unity processes these reports on our behalf; they are not linked to your account.
  • App stores: Apple and Google, when they process your purchases, subscriptions or refunds under their own privacy policies, and for app distribution and (if enabled) push notifications.
  • Professional advisers and authorities where required by law, to enforce our terms, or to protect the rights, safety and integrity of players and the Services.
  • A buyer or successor in a merger, acquisition or asset sale — with notice to you and continuity of this policy's protections.
  • Other players see only what the game shows: your display name, avatar, country flag (if set), and gameplay results (scores, leaderboards, match outcomes).

All processors act under contracts (data processing agreements) that restrict them to processing on our instructions with appropriate security.

4. International transfers

We are a South African company, but your personal information is stored on our behalf by Amazon Web Services in the United States. Wherever you play from, your information is therefore transferred to, and processed in, the United States:

  • From the EU/EEA/UK: neither South Africa nor the United States (outside the EU-US Data Privacy Framework) is covered by a European Commission adequacy decision for our purposes, so these transfers rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (and the UK Addendum/IDTA), entered into by us and flowed down to our processors, together with the security measures described in section 8.
  • From South Africa: your information is transferred outside the Republic to the United States. We rely on section 72(1)(b) of POPIA: the transfer is necessary for the performance of our agreement with you (operating your account and the Game), and our processors are bound by written agreements imposing data-protection obligations substantially similar to POPIA.
  • Crash and diagnostic reports (section 1f) are processed by Unity Technologies, including in the United States, under Unity's data processing terms, which incorporate the Standard Contractual Clauses.
  • In transit: requests travel through Cloudflare's global network, which may route and process them outside South Africa in order to deliver them securely. Cloudflare acts as our processor under its data processing addendum, which incorporates the Standard Contractual Clauses.
  • Other countries: we apply the same contractual safeguards.

You may request a copy of the relevant safeguards via privacy@fourxgames.com.

5. How long we keep it

DataRetention
Account, profile, progressionWhile your account is active; deleted or de-identified within 30 days of account deletion
Mid-round saved games72 hours, after which the save expires and can no longer be restored
Sign-in refresh tokensUp to 90 days, rotating
Gameplay/shot records and statisticsLife of the account; deleted with the account
Anti-cheat flags and enforcement recordsKept while the account exists, and with the enforcement action; deleted with the account
Purchase/transaction recordsAs required by tax and company law (South Africa: generally 5 years) — retained even after account deletion, de-linked where feasible
Server logs and diagnostics90 days, then automatically discarded
Crash and diagnostic reports (section 1f)Kept in Unity's Diagnostics service for the retention period Unity applies to that service, then deleted by Unity. They are not linked to your account, so they are not deleted with it.
Support correspondence24 months
BackupsEncrypted automated backups: database snapshots kept 14 days, and nightly encrypted copies held in two separate United States data centres for 30 days (plus up to 5 more days before a replaced copy is purged). Deleted data therefore leaves every backup within 65 days of your deletion request (the 30-day deletion deadline plus the backup lifetime). Backups are used only to restore the service after a failure, never to bring back a deleted account.

6. Your rights

Everyone: you can access and update most profile data in the Game, and you can delete your account in the Game (Settings ▸ Legal & Account ▸ Delete account) or at https://FourXGames.com/delete-account.

EU/EEA/UK (GDPR): right of access; rectification; erasure; restriction; portability; objection (including to legitimate-interests processing such as anti-cheat — we will stop unless we have compelling legitimate grounds, which for anti-cheat we generally will while you play competitive modes); withdrawal of consent; and the right to complain to your supervisory authority.

South Africa (POPIA): rights of access and correction (sections 23–24, via the form prescribed under PAIA where applicable); deletion/destruction (section 24); objection (section 11(3)); and the right to complain to the Information Regulator (South Africa) — Woodmead North Office Park, 54 Maxwell Drive, Woodmead, Johannesburg, 2191; complaints email: POPIAComplaints@inforegulator.org.za. Our PAIA/POPIA manual is available at https://www.fourxgames.com/paia/.

California (CCPA/CPRA) and other US states: right to know/access; delete; correct; portability; and non-discrimination. We do not sell or share personal information (as those terms are defined in the CPRA), and we do not use or disclose sensitive personal information for purposes requiring a right to limit. Authorised agents may submit requests.

How to exercise rights: email privacy@fourxgames.com from your account email, or use the in-Game tools. We respond within one month (GDPR), 45 days (CCPA) or the POPIA-prescribed period, and we may need to verify your identity. We will not discriminate against you for exercising rights.

7. Children

The Services are not directed at children. You must be at least 13 years old to use them, and if you are under 18 you may use them only with the permission of a parent or guardian (Terms, clause 1.2).

We do not ask your age when you start playing, so we do not verify it. The Game is a general-audience golf game: we collect no real names, no location, no contacts, no photos and no advertising identifiers, and it contains no chat or messaging. We ask for a date of birth once, before a first purchase, and we keep only the date on which you become old enough — never the date of birth itself.

If you are a parent or guardian and believe a child has an account you did not agree to, email privacy@fourxgames.com and we will delete the account and everything held with it. We will act on that without asking you to prove anything beyond being the parent or guardian.

8. Security

We protect personal information with, among other measures: encryption in transit (TLS); passwords stored as salted bcrypt hashes; short-lived, signed access tokens; server-side authoritative game logic (clients cannot write scores directly); a separate database per service; encrypted, access-controlled backups held separately from the live systems; restricting administrative access to those who need it; and logging and monitoring. No system is 100% secure; if a breach creates a risk to you, we will notify you and the relevant regulator (including the Information Regulator under POPIA section 22 and GDPR Article 33/34 timelines) without undue delay.

9. Your choices

  • Play as guest (no email required) — with the trade-off in Terms clause 2.1.
  • Notifications — off unless you opt in; disable any time in device settings.
  • Country/avatar/display name — optional and editable.
  • Marketing — none without opt-in consent.

10. Changes to this policy

We will post changes on this page with a new effective date, and give in-Game or email notice of material changes at least 30 days in advance where practicable.
